title: Radiating Tales

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Whatchya need Darlin?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatchya need Darlin?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: A message? Lookin' to send a beacon in the dark, huh? Alright, I'll bite. What can I bring to life for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A message? Lookin' to send a beacon in the dark, huh? Alright, I'll bite. What can I bring to life for you?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: That's right. You got a bit of a shine to you. Your aura radiates, same as me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's right. You got a bit of a shine to you. Your aura radiates, same as me.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Whelp! Can't blame me for trying. What can lil' ol' me do for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whelp! Can't blame me for trying. What can lil' ol' me do for you?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Loneliness. A fleeting dream or hint of some aroma once found pleasurable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Loneliness. A fleeting dream or hint of some aroma once found pleasurable.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Scent is but one sense. It's when they mix, combine and swirl into a spiraling helix of emotions. Whoo, almost got ahead of myself there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Scent is but one sense. It's when they mix, combine and swirl into a spiraling helix of emotions. Whoo, almost got ahead of myself there.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: That there's another. Someone intertwined with the person I'm speaking with right now. Hmm. If you find yourself needing space, you should seek me out again. You know, when you're not here trying to do business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That there's another. Someone intertwined with the person I'm speaking with right now. Hmm. If you find yourself needing space, you should seek me out again. You know, when you're not here trying to do business.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: You're a rainbow. There are so many colors I'd like to paint you with.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a rainbow. There are so many colors I'd like to paint you with.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Mhmmm, darlin' you do what you wanna do. And what's that gonna be tonight?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mhmmm, darlin' you do what you wanna do. And what's that gonna be tonight?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: I am.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: "Cab" Captain or like "Captain" Captain?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Cab" Captain or like "Captain" Captain?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Never heard of 'em.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never heard of 'em.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Ooooohhhhh. I like this. Alright. Yeah, I got you. Give me a few and I'll get it out there. Already thinking about the colors... oh, the colors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ooooohhhhh. I like this. Alright. Yeah, I got you. Give me a few and I'll get it out there. Already thinking about the colors... oh, the colors.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Darlin?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Darlin?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Need some help getting a message out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Need some help getting a message out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Need some help getting a message out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Need some help getting a message out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're a visual artist, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a visual artist, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, but actually just looking for a favor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, but actually just looking for a favor.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thanks, but actually just looking for a favor.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thanks, but actually just looking for a favor.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What am I radiating?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What am I radiating?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds a little romantic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds a little romantic.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you're smelling your own paint fumes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you're smelling your own paint fumes.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you're smelling your own paint fumes.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you're smelling your own paint fumes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll have to come see you sometime.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll have to come see you sometime.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll have to come see you sometime.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll have to come see you sometime.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Probably just gonna focus on this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Probably just gonna focus on this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Probably just gonna focus on this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Probably just gonna focus on this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Captain Taylor Hernz.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Captain Taylor Hernz.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Cab Captain?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cab Captain?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Captain Captain?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Captain Captain?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's a joke. Total washup wannabe pirate who was born way too late.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's a joke. Total washup wannabe pirate who was born way too late.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He's a joke. Total washup wannabe pirate who was born way too late.
